what.text: Internal displacement occurred within Myanmar, and people also sought protection abroad as refugees and asylum seekers.
In 2025, UNHCR recorded 3628840 internally displaced persons and 1524378 refugees originating from Myanmar.
The sources don't say which specific countries hosted these refugees.

why.text: Conflict episodes involved the Government of Myanmar (Burma) and groups such as KNU, KNPP, MNDAA, KIO, and NUG.
Disaster events were also recorded as causing displacement movements inside the country.
The sources don't say additional details about specific individual reasons for moving.

when.text: Refugee figures were recorded at 160000 in 1978 and 1156742 in 2017.
Internal displacement reported by UNHCR stood at 671011 in 2021 and 3628840 in 2025.
New disaster displacements were recorded at 2250000 in 2008.

how.text: Displaced populations are counted through end-of-year totals and new movement counts by UNHCR and IDMC.
The sources don't say what physical means of travel were used or what types of shelter people live in.
